verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring work is a fair question for a docs platform with AI agents and automation, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no way to create recurring or scheduled jobs. GitBook Agent flagging outdated content, auto translations, Git Sync, the CLI and the REST API are related automation or developer building blocks, not a documented recurring scheduler, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
